24/S0.subgoal: Describe the three classes of users (novice, intermittent, and expert) and how they influence design decisions.

24/S1.subgoal: Describe different design perspectives and the software development lifecycle required to address user needs.

24/S2.subgoal: Explain the ISO definition of usability and its three measures: effectiveness, efficiency, and satisfaction.

24/S3.subgoal: Describe the concept of user-centered design and its related terms.

24/S4.subgoal: Explain how XR systems relate to interactive systems and the importance of human factors in their design.
